relevance: The claimed proof (20 November 2026): a four-page note plus a Lean 4 archive (about 175,000 files) proving Mathlib's statement RiemannHypothesis and GRH for Dirichlet L-functions. Independent proof checkers accept it (A. Sutherland's verification page, https://math.mit.edu/~drew/grh/), but no readable proof exists. It is the primary source for all current work on this problem: checking the formal statements and definitions, reproducing the checks, and mapping the formal proof into readable mathematics (direction D-38). Not peer-reviewed; the Clay Institute still lists RH as open.
title: Note on a proof of the Riemann hypothesis found with Claude (with the Lean 4 archive)
